evals.prompt: Dobbiamo fare la DMA per la prima volta. Siamo un'azienda alimentare con 500 dipendenti. Da dove partiamo?
evals.expected_output: Starts Phase 1 (company context), asks about specific food sub-sector, supply chain, then guides through IRO identification.
assertions: Starts with company context questions, not the full IRO list
Asks one question at a time
References food/beverage sector IROs from reference file
Explains double materiality concept (impact + financial) in simple terms

evals.prompt: Our auditor says our DMA documentation is insufficient. What exactly do they need to see?
evals.expected_output: Lists specific documentation requirements: methodology, stakeholder list, scoring criteria, threshold justification, results.
assertions: Lists specific auditor requirements from ESRS 1
Explains scoring methodology must be traceable
